summary_hint: Homeowner's quote from Universal P&C for 42 Oak St — Dwelling (Cov A) $410,000, replacement-cost basis, $2,500 deductible, annual premium $1,840, valid through 09/15/2026.

typed_core.name: insurance_carrier
typed_core.why: identity — the risk-bearing carrier; source validation

typed_core.name: quote_valid_through_date
typed_core.why: processor — must be valid through closing (cheap future rule)

typed_core.name: proposed_effective_date
typed_core.why: processor — coverage must start on/before closing

typed_core.name: named_insured_count
typed_core.why: disambiguator — flags a bad name split

typed_core.name: dwelling_coverage_a
typed_core.prompt_hint: Coverage letters are fixed: A dwelling, B other structures, C personal property, D loss of use, E personal liability, F medical payments — map by letter, not position

typed_core.name: replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis
typed_core.why: processor/disambiguator — the IH-1 field: dwelling settlement basis (RCV vs ACV)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Carry the policy_form / ISO code alongside so the dwelling basis is not confused with the personal-property basis. ISO form code implies the settlement basis when no words state it (HO-3 = replacement cost, HO-8 = ACV/modified)

nested_lists.name: mortgagee_or_lienholder_entries
nested_lists.shape_reason: 1–3 entries; flat rows support a mortgagee-clause verification. Serves lender-listed-correctly checks

fields.name: loan_number
fields.why: mortgagee-clause verification — the lender's own identifier (not borrower PII)

fields.name: clause_address
fields.why: mortgagee-clause verification — the clause mailing address

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: classification/version metadata; policy_status is the real status

rejected.name: issuer_name, issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: insurance_carrier + agency_or_producer_name carry source and contact

rejected.name: statement_period_start/end, document_issue_date
rejected.reason: duplicate/adjacent to policy term and quote dates

rejected.name: policy_form
rejected.reason: folded into the disambiguator note beside replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis; capture the ISO code in the snippet

rejected.name: covered_perils_forms_and_endorsements
rejected.reason: string[] list; no consumer beyond the form code already carried; catch-all

rejected.name: ordinance_or_law_coverage, wind_hail_hurricane_coverage, cancellation_or_nonrenewal_notice, underwriting_assumptions, conditions_to_bind
rejected.reason: detail objects/lists with no consumer today; catch-all

encoding_variations: replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis — the canonical trap: stated as an explicit flag ('Dwelling RCV: Y' beside 'Personal Property RCV: N'), as an ISO form code only ('HO 00 03'), or as prose ('replacement cost settlement applies'). Carry the policy_form / ISO code alongside so the dwelling basis is not confused with the personal-property basis
dwelling_coverage_a — 'Coverage A', 'Dwelling', 'Cov A'; always tie the amount to its coverage letter — an extractor matching a bare dollar figure can grab Coverage C
annual_premium — annual vs 6-month vs monthly; carry the term, and read estimated_or_final_premium_indicator beside it

open_questions.q: Which one nested list? mortgagee_or_lienholder_entries vs deductibles — both CORE object[]
open_questions.recommendation: nest mortgagee_entries (needed to verify the lender clause) and add a flat wind_hail_deductible / all_perils_deductible pair if a rule needs deductibles, rather than a second list

open_questions.q: replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis reliability — should the schema carry policy_form (ISO code) as its own typed field to guarantee the disambiguator survives?
options: carry policy_form as its own typed field
keep the ISO code in the snippet
open_questions.recommendation: yes if an IH-1-style rule is activated — otherwise keep the code in the snippet and revisit

open_questions.q: policy_number masking — pre-mask at extraction vs raw-then-snapshot

notes: No rules consume this type today, so there is no rule floor — but this is the exact document family behind LP-431 / IH-1, where the dwelling loss-settlement basis was read correctly yet landed in the discarded catch-all. So replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis and dwelling_coverage_a are typed even absent a live rule, and the disambiguator discipline is applied hard here.
deductibles is NOT nested (one-list budget) — wind/hail deductibles matter but are carried flat if a rule needs them.
PII: named insureds are standard. Mortgagee entries may embed the loan number (confidential) in source — acceptable as it is the lender's own identifier, not borrower PII.

Prompt hint (doc-level): A quote is not proof of coverage; binding_status / policy_status / estimated_or_final_premium_indicator distinguish an indicative quote from a bound policy — do not treat a quote as an active policy.

Ambiguity: dwelling_coverage_a and annual_premium are tagged 'headline' (not a defined reason_class); classified as processor. replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis is tagged 'processor/disambiguator'; classified as disambiguator (the §3 disambiguator field the doc emphasizes).
